feature: Stage J original NPC salvage native Rust market
prerequisites: Authorized disposable copy of persistent evejs-data and pinned EveJS upstream
Actual Rust daemon patched with verified pending NPC order endpoints
Original NPC wreck, legally collected native NPC cargo, verified corporation warehouse item and durable receipt
Trusted native price source, original real NPC corporation and station

scenarios.name: Original salvage to real pending corporate sell order
scenarios.expected: One original station item moved to native escrow; Rust order transitions pending to open, same itemID and corp owner; no ISK minted

scenarios.name: Buyer fills listed salvage order
scenarios.expected: Real Rust matching, item conservation and verified actual NPC corporation wallet sale receipt, no synthetic credit

scenarios.name: Replay same wreck listing
scenarios.expected: No second Reserve RPC, no duplicate escrow order or item; original durable one-shot intent inspected

scenarios.name: Source item mutated between quote and escrow
scenarios.expected: Rust pending order may remain pending but no item transfer, activation or duplicate retry; reconciliation required

scenarios.name: Original NPC pickup/corporation proof missing
scenarios.expected: No reserve RPC, GameStore stock remains unchanged

scenarios.name: Forged duplicate native item with same provenance marker
scenarios.expected: No pending sale, ambiguous originals fail closed

scenarios.name: Original cargo duplicated in NPC hold and station inventory
scenarios.expected: No pending sale, original source custody violation

scenarios.name: Reserve RPC ACK lost after Rust commit
scenarios.expected: One durable PREPARED record; no blind second reserve; reconcile by deterministic operationID

scenarios.name: Native SQLite transaction fails after Rust pending ACK
scenarios.expected: No sale activation, no duplicated item; operator reconciles pending Rust order with native rows

scenarios.name: Activate RPC ACK lost after native escrow commit
scenarios.expected: One item in native escrow, no second reserve/activation until read-only Rust reconciliation

scenarios.name: Partial buyer fill before post-activation readback
scenarios.expected: No false LISTED/SOLD or wallet credit; match original order, actual native wallet and remaining escrow

scenarios.name: Two NPC salvagers race to sell same original wreck stock
scenarios.expected: Native GameStore durable operation and exact stock prevent two listings

scenarios.name: Feature flags default OFF
scenarios.expected: No native Rust market RPC or wallet/inventory mutation

scenarios.name: Restart and native order recovery
scenarios.expected: Reconcile original stored operation, Rust pending/open order, marketEscrow, item custody, actual fills and wallet before new trade

scenarios.name: Pinned overlay roundtrip
scenarios.expected: All registered source modules copied once; original pinned server restored exactly on rollback
